name: Laws of Bermuda (the consolidated laws of Bermuda Laws Online)
label: Bermuda
record_note: Bermuda Laws Online publishes only the current consolidation, so each law has one version here: the text as of the day its PDF was produced. Earlier text is not available; history notes and "Amended by" lists are kept as text and in data/amendments.csv.

dates.commit: consolidation day (the CreationDate of each consolidated PDF)
dates.time: 12:00 Bermuda time (UTC-4; UTC-3 in daylight time)

scope.when_absent: not extracted for Bermuda; savings and transitional rules are in the amending laws

default_reach.rule: presumption against retroactivity; savings on repeal
default_reach.meaning: unless the contrary intention appears, a repeal does not revive anything not in force, nor affect the previous operation of the repealed enactment, rights or liabilities accrued under it, or proceedings in respect of them
default_reach.authority: common-law presumption; Interpretation Act 1951 (Bermuda), section 16 (effect of repeal on rights, liabilities, etc., under repealed Act); see interpretation-act-1951/section-16.md
